The combination of skin peeling/rashes and joint pain strongly points to psoriasis. Psoriasis is an autoimmune disease that causes rapid buildup of skin cells, leading to scaling on the skin's surface. It can also cause joint pain (psoriatic arthritis).

- Fungal infection: [8] itching, rash, different color patches, pimples/nodules. No joint pain.
- Dengue: [14] extreme body pain, headache, vomiting, red spots. Not primarily skin peeling.

The most direct match from the references is psoriasis. Reference [1] and [7] explicitly link "skin peeling/flaky/scaly spots" and "rash on arms/legs" with "joint pain" to psoriasis.

Therefore, the diagnosis is psoriasis.
